description: NaMoO₂PO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.77 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.20 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-2.19 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-50°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-45°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.56 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mo, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom.
